reason: Retain this existing shared Linux probe and applied-boundary suite at a ceiling of 804 measured lines, reduced from 810 by replacing the shell error wording assertion with a typed syscall result. It holds the common helper launch, capability admission and paired process/network/filesystem controls. New metadata and stream behaviors have their own focused suites rather than growing this probe. This bounded retention preserves the shipped helper contracts while avoiding a speculative reorganization in a security fix; the complete selected Linux contracts support it.
